```{r load_table}
trend_table_ca <- read_table('../data/popgen/gwas/tests/CA_trend.model')
no_na_ca <- drop_na(trend_table_ca)
```


```{r Manhattan_plot}
## Cochran-Armitage Trend test
trend_test_only <- no_na_ca[no_na_ca$TEST %in% c('TREND'),]

#have to turn SNP (CHR:BP:) into just BP
trend_test_only <- trend_test_only %>%
  mutate(SNP = str_extract(SNP, "(?<=:)[0-9]+(?=:)")) %>%
  rename(BP = SNP)
trend_test_only <- trend_test_only %>% mutate_at(c('CHR','P', 'BP'), as.numeric)


gene_list_trend_test_pvalue <- filter(trend_test_only, -log10(P) >= 2.5 )


chr_lengths <- read_table('../genome/per_chr_total_BP.tsv', col_names = c('Chromosome','length'))

qtl <- read_table('../data/candidate_genes/original_QTL_analysis/wiese_eye_intervals.txt')

ca_plot <- ggplot(data = gene_list_trend_test_pvalue, aes(x=as.factor(BP), y=-log10(P), colour = as.factor(CHR))) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 9) +
  #facet_grid(~CHR, scales = 'free_x', space = 'free_x', switch = 'x') 
  geom_rect(
    data = qtl,
    aes(
      xmin = Start,
      xmax = Stop,
      ymin = -0.5,
      ymax = 0,
      fill = Trait
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +

  facet_grid(
    ~CHR,
    scales = "free_x",
    space = "free_x",
    switch = "x"
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-0.5, NA))
ca_plot
ggsave('Cochran-Armitage_trend_test_wQTL.svg', plot=ca_plot)



stop()
#make chr different colors
ca_plot <- ggplot(data=trend_test_only, aes(x=as.factor(BP), y=-log10(P), colour=factor(CHR))) +  #x as factor can either parses/spaces by SNP/BP or by CHR #fill=?
  scale_color_manual(values = rep(c("grey", "orange3"), 22 )) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 9, linetype="dotted") + #makes a p-value cut off
  geom_point(stat="identity") +
  geom_point(aes(colour = -log10(P) > 9),
             show.legend = FALSE) +
  facet_grid(~CHR, scales = 'free_x', space = 'free_x', switch = 'x') + #makes the x axis have chr squares?
  theme_classic() + 
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
        panel.spacing = unit(0, "lines")) +
  #scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) + #try with or without

  labs(x="CHR", title="Cochran-Armitage")
#ca_plot
gene_list = subset(trend_test_only, P<= 1e-9)
ggsave('Cochran-Armitage trend test.png', plot=ca_plot)

```

```{r}
## Cochran-Armitage Trend test
trend_test_only <- no_na_ca[no_na_ca$TEST %in% c('TREND'),]

#have to turn SNP (CHR:BP:) into just BP
trend_test_only <- trend_test_only %>%
  mutate(SNP = str_extract(SNP, "(?<=:)[0-9]+(?=:)")) %>%
  rename(BP = SNP)
trend_test_only <- trend_test_only %>% mutate_at(c('CHR','P', 'BP'), as.numeric)


gene_list_trend_test_pvalue <- filter(trend_test_only, -log10(P) >= 2.5 )


chr_lengths <- read_table('../genome/per_chr_total_BP.tsv', col_names = c('CHR','length'))

qtl <- read_table('../data/candidate_genes/original_QTL_analysis/wiese_eye_intervals.txt')
colnames(qtl) <- c('Trait', 'CHR', 'Start', 'Stop')

col_names = c('Trait', 'CHR', 'Start', 'Stop')

chr_ends <- data.frame(
  CHR = chr_lengths$CHR,
  BP = chr_lengths$length,
  P = 1 # gives -log10(P)=0
)

# chromosome background bars
chr_track <- data.frame(
  CHR = chr_lengths$CHR,
  xmin = 0,
  xmax = chr_lengths$length,
  ymin = -0.75,
  ymax = -0.25
)

p <- ggplot(
  gene_list_trend_test_pvalue,
  aes(
    x = BP,
    y = -log10(P)
    )
  ) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_blank(data = chr_ends, aes(x=BP, y=0))+
  

  # chromosome outline/background
  geom_rect(
    data = chr_track,
    aes(
      xmin = xmin,
      xmax = xmax,
      ymin = ymin,
      ymax = ymax
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    fill = "grey90",
    colour = "black"
  ) +

  # QTL intervals
  geom_rect(
    data = qtl,
    aes(
      xmin = Start,
      xmax = Stop,
      ymin = -0.75,
      ymax = -0.25
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    fill = "steelblue"
  ) +

  # GWAS points
  geom_point(
    aes(colour = factor(CHR)),
    alpha = 0.7,
    size = 1
  ) +

  geom_hline(yintercept = 9, linetype = 2) +

  facet_grid(
    ~CHR,
    scales = "free_x",
    space = "free_x",
    switch = "x"
  ) +

  coord_cartesian(
    ylim = c(-0.8, max(-log10(gene_list_trend_test_pvalue$P), na.rm=TRUE))
  ) +

  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    panel.spacing.x = unit(0.2, "lines"),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none"
  ) +

  xlab("Position (bp)") +
  ylab(expression(-logP))

p

ggsave('CA_trend_and_QTL.svg', plot=p)
ggsave('CA_trend_and_QTL.png', plot = p)
```
